notes: Independent ranking-evidence audit of all 15 discovery and diamond candidates. Read the existing fee audit for context; this file replaces difficulty and metrics only, leaving all fee-route decisions unchanged.

Difficulty is a provisional agent judgment within a venue-relevant part of operations research, stochastic modeling or simulation, not a measured acceptance probability or one cross-disciplinary prestige ladder. Five high bands rest on explicit contribution/selectivity evidence; ten remain unknown. No very_high or moderate band is assigned without a defensible basis.

Current official author/editorial pages were inspected for all candidates, using the associated ROADEF society page for RAIRO because the journal home and aims pages were HTTP 403. Latest readable official citation metrics and selected historical selectivity context are recorded; this is not an exhaustive metric-history compilation.

Sage overview-metric pages were readable through official description/overview navigation despite intermittent direct-open timeouts and a shell HTTP 403. The visible rates were SIM 3.6%, SAG 11.1%, DMS 28.8%; no reporting year/window or denominator was exposed in the rendered overview. A linked metric control resolved to the same overview, not a usable definition. All three retain null year and unknown population.

SORT annual rejection statistics use total articles submitted as their stated denominator but do not define submission cohorts, pending-case handling or counts. Preserve rejection rates as published; do not calculate acceptance as their complement.

Operations Research 2025 annual-report dashboard explicitly labels 2025 Q1-Q3 and separately reports acceptance 17.3%; the acceptance denominator is not defined. Adjacent submission and acceptance counts are not a proven cohort and are not divided. CRORR acceptance/rejection values are explicitly historical 2020, not current estimates. ORD reports only a since 2025-01-01 interval with an unspecified end.

Official INFORMS JCR rank tables cover 2024 even where the journal homepages now give 2025 impact factors. Each metric retains its own year. Five-year impact values on INFORMS homepages were omitted because their own year was not explicitly shown; Springer five-year values are explicitly labeled 2025.

Citation and category metrics describe journal citation populations, not manuscript selectivity; underlying citation counts are left unspecified when absent. No third-party metric estimate, invented acceptance percentage, inferred current-year label or guaranteed acceptance claim is used.
Source checks are an agent evidence audit, not human scientific review, permission to submit, or a claim that an individual manuscript satisfies the stated contribution thresholds.
